summary: Anteroom onboarding flow tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS covering register (fresh/duplicate/invalid email/short pw), login (valid/invalid email/wrong pw), /auth/me (valid/no/bogus token), profile update (valid/invalid dob/invalid language), logout invalidates token, and health. Frontend: welcome, onboarding entry, auth signup + profile setup + dashboard render + session persistence + sign-out all working. ONE frontend bug: Onboarding 'Next' button does not advance the FlatList carousel from slide 1 to slide 2 on Expo web preview (dot indicator stays on slide 1 and CTA never becomes 'Create account'). Users cannot reach auth via the onboarding path on web. Also two testID naming mismatches vs review spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing onboarding-next-btn calls listRef.current?.scrollToIndex but the FlatList does not advance on Expo web preview. Dot indicator stays on slide 1 and CTA label remains 'Next' (never becomes 'Create account'), so user cannot reach /auth?mode=signup from onboarding on web. Direct navigation to /auth works, and login path works, so only the onboarding carousel is affected.

react_native_issues.issue: FlatList horizontal pagingEnabled with scrollToIndex is unreliable on react-native-web. Consider using ScrollView with scrollTo({x}) or a Reanimated Carousel, or update index state directly in next() (setIndex(index+1)) and also scrollToOffset with x=index*SCREEN_W as a fallback.

action_items: Fix onboarding Next button: on web, FlatList.scrollToIndex does not advance the pager. Update next() to also call setIndex(index+1) and use scrollToOffset({offset:(index+1)*SCREEN_W, animated:true}), or replace FlatList with ScrollView.

Optional: align country selector testID with review spec — spec says 'profile-country-btn' but code uses 'profile-country-select' (country options are 'profile-country-option-{ISO}'). Either update spec or rename to 'profile-country-btn'.

Optional: dashboard sign-out testID — code uses testID 'profile-signout-btn' inside profile-setup and appears to auto sign out via tapping dashboard-avatar (no explicit menu button; avatar tap alone triggered sign-out and returned to welcome-screen in test). Consider adding a labeled 'dashboard-signout-btn' for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean, uses async motor, bcrypt, TTL index on sessions, proper 401/409/422/400 responses. LGTM.
onboarding.tsx: relies on FlatList.scrollToIndex from a button; unreliable on react-native-web. next() should also update state and use scrollToOffset for cross-platform reliability.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of onboarding Next bug: In /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx, next() calls listRef.current?.scrollToIndex({index: index+1, animated:true}). On react-native-web, FlatList's scrollToIndex does not consistently scroll a horizontally paginated list; the underlying scroll container isn't repositioned, so the onScroll handler never fires and `index` state stays at 0. Result: CTA label stays 'Next' and users are stuck on slide 1. Fix: (1) setIndex(index+1) immediately in next(); (2) use listRef.current?.scrollToOffset({offset:(index+1)*SCREEN_W, animated:true}); (3) or replace FlatList with a horizontal ScrollView + Animated.event. Reproduction: open /, tap 'Get started', tap 'Next' — carousel does not advance.
